reportsPage.title: My Reports
reportsPage.subtitle: Reports turn data into clear next steps: what's happening, why, and what to do next.
reportsPage.emptyBody: Create your first report to get a clear summary and personalized next steps.
reportsPage.settingsIntro: We'll gather your latest data and present the observations in a clear format: what's happening now, why, and what gentle step will help next.
reportsPage.topicPlaceholder: For example: why am I not sleeping well?
reportsPage.secondOpinionOn: The Second Opinion Engine (multi-model) is always on
reportsPage.secondOpinionBody: Every report includes two independent analyses plus a unified aggregation.
reportsPage.typeGeneralBody: Learn what's happening with your body overall: sleep, energy, recovery, load adaptation.
reportsPage.typeThematicBody: Deep analysis of one area: sleep, stress, recovery, nutrition, glucose.
reportsPage.typeDynamicBody: Compare your state with previous reports and see trends.
reportsPage.typeDynamicLocked: Available after creating 2 or more reports
reportsPage.typeDeviceBody: Complete analysis with automatic integration of metrics from your devices.
reportsPage.unifiedBody: Two model perspectives merged into one coherent report.
reportsPage.planTitle: Want to turn recommendations into a plan?
reportsPage.planBody: We will help turn the report's findings into an action plan with gentle steps that realistically fit into your life.
reportsPage.notesPlaceholder: Add personal notes about this report…
